:::{#exm-weighted-sum}
#### The total price of a shopping basket

A basket holds $3$ items that cost $\$2$ each and $2$ items that cost $\$5$ each.
The total price is the weighted sum of the prices $2$ and $5$
with weights $3$ and $2$, the number of items at each price:

$$
\ba
3 \cd 2 + 2 \cd 5
&= 6 + 10
&& \text{(multiply each price by its weight)}
\\
&= 16
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

:::
